note: Names, descriptions and grades are exactly as PlayStation publishes them (verified against Exophase and PSNProfiles, 2026-11-20). Guides are written for this entry in its own words; where no published guide confirms a specific place or step, the guide says so instead of inventing one.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops automatically — it is always the last trophy you earn. The long pole is A Long Road, the Gold for 100% completion, so treat the roadmap's final stage as the real work. PowerPyx puts the whole run at roughly 200 hours at difficulty 4 out of 10, with the story alone taking 50 to 60 hours. There is no shortcut: every other trophy in this list has to be earned first.
sources: FullSweep — trophy list, summarising PowerPyx and GTABase

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Complete the opening mission, Gone Fishing — the first mission of the story. It unlocks as part of the campaign, so there is nothing to hunt for and nothing to miss. Just play the story from the start and it pops when the mission ends.
sources: Of Zen and Computing — hidden trophy list

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 of the campaign. Story chapters unlock in order, so this is the first chapter trophy and it comes from playing the story, not from any side activity. No published guide names the chapter's closing mission beyond the chapter itself, so keep playing until the chapter closes.
sources: Of Zen and Computing — hidden trophy list

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies it is unmissable story progress — complete the chapter's missions in order and it unlocks at the chapter's end. The exact closing mission is not named in any published guide yet; the official description is the only confirmed detail.
sources: Of Zen and Computing — hidden trophy list

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. It is story progress like the other chapter trophies: play the chapter's missions in order and it unlocks when the chapter ends. No published guide yet names the closing mission, so the official description is the confirmed fact.
sources: Of Zen and Computing — hidden trophy list

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Play the chapter's missions in order and the trophy unlocks at the chapter's end — it cannot be missed by skipping side content. No published guide yet names the closing mission, so the official description is the confirmed fact.
sources: Of Zen and Computing — hidden trophy list

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the campaign — the last mission of Chapter 5, and the second Gold in the list. Once the credits roll you can keep exploring Leonida freely, which is when the cleanup stages of this guide's roadmap begin (Push Square). Nothing about it can be missed: finish the story and it is yours.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Named story missions unlock as you play the campaign in order; the mission's position in the chapter is not spelled out in any published guide yet. Play the story and it comes to you — there is no side requirement.
sources: Of Zen and Computing — hidden trophy list

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. It is a named story mission, so it unlocks by playing the campaign in order — no side activity feeds into it. No published guide yet details the mission's steps, so the official description is the confirmed fact.
sources: Of Zen and Computing — hidden trophy list

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. A named story mission that unlocks in campaign order, with no side requirement. No published guide yet details its steps, so the official description is the confirmed fact.
sources: Of Zen and Computing — hidden trophy list

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. A named story mission that unlocks in campaign order, with no side requirement. No published guide yet details its steps, so the official description is the confirmed fact.
sources: Of Zen and Computing — hidden trophy list

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown, a story mission at Vice City International Airport. It unlocks in campaign order like the other named missions. No published guide yet details its steps, so the official description is the confirmed fact.
sources: Of Zen and Computing — hidden trophy list

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. A named story mission that unlocks in campaign order, with no side requirement. No published guide yet details its steps, so the official description is the confirmed fact.
sources: Of Zen and Computing — hidden trophy list

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the game's completion checklist. The checklist itself only appears after you finish the story (Touch Pad, then Progress, then 100% Completion), but progress you made earlier counts toward it (Push Square). It covers story, activities, collectibles and challenges — 15 of the 18 collectible card sets count toward it, for example — so this trophy is the last real goal before the Platinum. No published source lists the full checklist line by line yet, so use the in-game checklist once it unlocks.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife-edge flights and base jumps all count, and you can mix them (GTA Zone, from PowerPyx and GTABase). The game tracks 397 stunts in total, and 100% completion wants 300 of them, so this trophy needs 250 of the 397. No published map of all stunt locations exists yet, so work through them as you explore Leonida.
sources: GTA Zone — trophy list, from PowerPyx and GTABase

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. The official list tracks 9 types; no published guide yet names all 9, so open the in-game activity list and try one of each. One attempt at each is enough — you do not need to win or master any of them.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 ranges (GTA Zone, from PowerPyx). Gold each challenge; the trophy tracks the 42 individually. No published guide yet maps every range or challenge, so visit each range on the map and work through its challenges until each shows gold.
sources: GTA Zone — trophy list, from PowerPyx and GTABase

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — one win at each of the 14 spots (GTA Zone). All 42 races count toward 100% completion, but this trophy needs only a single win per location. Drone races are an activity, so find the Top Fun spots on the map and win once at each.
sources: GTA Zone — trophy list, from PowerPyx and GTABase

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 in the game (GTA Zone). Winning the same race twice does not count — each win has to be a race you have not won before. Races are spread across Leonida, so mix vehicle types and keep track of which ones you have already won.
sources: GTA Zone — trophy list, from PowerPyx and GTABase

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is an activity in the game; take Cal's challenge and out-fish him. No published guide yet says where Cal's challenge triggers, so the official description is the only confirmed detail — look for the fishing challenge when it appears and beat his score.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game — finish any game on any arcade cabinet. No published guide yet names the cabinets or their games, so find an arcade machine, play one game through to its end, and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy is one of the side characters with a mission strand; play his missions through to the last one. The strand's missions unlock as you progress — no published guide yet lists Andy's mission names or order. Because it is a final mission, keep a manual save from just before it, just in case (Of Zen and Computing).
sources: Of Zen and Computing — hidden trophy list

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton is one of the side characters with a mission strand; play his missions through to the last one. No published guide yet lists Kenton's mission names or order. Because it is a final mission, keep a manual save from just before it, just in case (Of Zen and Computing).
sources: Of Zen and Computing — hidden trophy list

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy is one of the side characters with a mission strand; play his missions through to the last one. No published guide yet lists Billy's mission names or order. Because it is a final mission, keep a manual save from just before it, just in case (Of Zen and Computing).
sources: Of Zen and Computing — hidden trophy list

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. PowerPyx counts 14 stranger strands in the game, but only some count toward this trophy — Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are among those that do, while Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy and Billy do not (GTA Zone, from PowerPyx). Finish 8 of the counting strands; the side-character final missions (Andy, Billy, Tyrone) have their own trophies and do not count here.
sources: GTA Zone — trophy list, from PowerPyx and GTABase

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy is one of the side characters with a mission strand; play his missions through to the last one. No published guide yet lists Randy's mission names or order. Because it is a final mission, keep a manual save from just before it, just in case (Of Zen and Computing).
sources: Of Zen and Computing — hidden trophy list

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone is one of the side characters with a mission strand; play his missions through to the last one. No published guide yet lists Tyrone's mission names or order. Because it is a final mission, keep a manual save from just before it, just in case (Of Zen and Computing).
sources: Of Zen and Computing — hidden trophy list

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in 10 locations (GTA Zone, from PowerPyx). This is the one trophy PowerPyx and GTABase flag as possibly missable: the first meditation spot can only be used early in the story, in Chapter 1, so meditate there the first time you get the chance (FullSweep). Whether that spot is truly required is still unconfirmed, but doing it early costs nothing and removes the risk. Work through the remaining spots as you explore.
sources: GTA Zone — trophy list, from PowerPyx and GTABase
FullSweep — trophy list, summarising PowerPyx and GTABase

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunt is a side strand, and the target is a specific unique animal, not a random hunt. No published guide yet names the animal or where it appears, so follow Bret's strand when it opens and take the hunt it offers.
sources: Of Zen and Computing — hidden trophy list

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 card sets in the game (Push Square), and this trophy needs any 3 completed. Cards are a collectible found across Leonida; no published map of card locations exists yet, so collect as you explore and finish any 3 sets.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 different locations. WAiNK is an in-game app; each location counts once, so you need 100 distinct spots. No published guide yet maps the WAiNK spots, so use the app whenever you reach a new named place and the count climbs on its own.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges — 50 of the 80 challenges on the map (GTA Zone); 100% completion wants 70. Challenges are the open-world tasks tracked on the map, so pick off the easy ones first and the count builds up. No published guide yet lists all 80, so use the in-game challenge list.
sources: GTA Zone — trophy list, from PowerPyx and GTABase

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build your wanted level to 4 stars while your partner is with you, then lose the cops together. Do it somewhere with escape routes — open roads out of the city work better than dead ends — and keep your partner close until the stars clear.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Chain three shop robberies in a row while the wanted level stays up — if the stars drop between shops, the chain breaks and you start over. Plan a route past three shops, keep the getaway vehicle close, and do not stop to fight the police between stops.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Getting in — or scanning — 100 different vehicle types fills the tracker (Of Zen and Computing). Drive anything new you see; the count climbs as you meet new models across Leonida. No published list of all vehicle types exists yet, so variety is the method: new model, new count.
sources: Of Zen and Computing — trophy list

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the game's slow-down aiming mode; trigger it with five enemies in view and drop all five before it ends. Pick a spot with a cluster of enemies, and do not waste the window on a single target.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — Vice City International Airport. The official description is the whole brief: leave the airport in a way no timetable planned. No published guide yet confirms the exact trigger — whether it is a stolen plane, a runway stunt or something else — so try the obvious unscheduled exits at the airport and watch for the pop.
sources: Of Zen and Computing — hidden trophy list

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Rhinos are the game's tanks, and the trophy is tied to them somehow — the official description gives no step. No published guide yet confirms what counts: surviving a tank encounter, driving one or destroying one are all guesses, so the description alone is the confirmed fact. Try tank encounters as they come and note what pops.
sources: Of Zen and Computing — hidden trophy list

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Get in and out with no alarms and no witnesses — stealth is the requirement, not speed. Plan the approach, avoid cameras and staff sightlines, and leave before anyone raises the alarm.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. There are 8 vaults in the game and this trophy needs 5 of them (GTA Zone); 100% completion wants all 8. Vaults open up with an optional Chapter 4 mission, and each one brings a 4-star wanted level, so have a fast bike ready for the escape (GTA Zone).
sources: GTA Zone — trophy list, from PowerPyx and GTABase

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, hit it, and lose the pursuit afterward. The escape matters as much as the robbery — have a getaway planned before you strike.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — reveal every region of the map. PlayStation tracks 52 areas. Drive, fly and walk into every corner; the tracker fills as each area is revealed. No published map of the 52 areas exists yet, so use the in-game map's fog as your guide and sweep the regions you have not visited.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — one operation for each of the 9 gangs. Illegal operations are gang-run sites; hit one per gang and the tracker fills. No published guide yet lists the gangs or their sites, so work through the operations the map shows and keep count of which gangs you have covered.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Find the cocktail spot on Ocean Beach, order a drink, and take in the view. No published guide yet names the exact bar or prompt, so the official description is the confirmed detail — look for the beachfront cocktail spot and interact with it.
sources: Of Zen and Computing — hidden trophy list

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through a showroom — the classic GTA exit — and the trophy pops. No published guide yet names which showroom, so pick a vehicle showroom and make your exit through the glass.
sources: Of Zen and Computing — hidden trophy list

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl a game — the trophy is about the follow-through, so play it properly rather than just walking in. No published guide yet confirms the exact lane or prompt.
sources: Of Zen and Computing — hidden trophy list

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The official description is deliberately vague — this is a story trophy that unlocks during the campaign, tied to a partnership moment (Of Zen and Computing). No published guide yet names the mission or the moment, so play the story and it will come to you.
sources: Of Zen and Computing — hidden trophy list

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). PlayStation tracks a count to 500, so this is a long accumulation of choices across the campaign rather than a single moment. No published guide yet explains what counts as a choice toward the 500; keep playing the story, make choices when offered, and the count climbs.
sources: Of Zen and Computing — hidden trophy list

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The official description hints at succeeding on a second attempt — a story moment where the first try fails and the retry lands. No published guide yet names the mission, so this is one to pick up by playing the story, not by hunting.
sources: Of Zen and Computing — hidden trophy list

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? A story trophy for a strange moment in the campaign — the description is the whole clue, and no published guide yet names the scene. Play the story and it unlocks when the moment arrives.
sources: Of Zen and Computing — hidden trophy list

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Take out a target with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a drive-by with a melee weapon, not a gun. No published guide yet confirms the exact setup, so find a slow-moving target, line up beside it, and swing as you pass.
sources: Of Zen and Computing — hidden trophy list

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills are dirty money you clean through your contacts; the trophy tracks the total laundered up to $250,000. It accumulates across the whole game, so keep laundering as bills come in rather than saving it for the end.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Any spending in any shop counts and it accumulates, so it fills naturally as you buy weapons, clothes, food and gear. If you are close at the end, top it up with a big purchase.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — all 8 of them. Garages are properties you buy across Leonida; each purchase counts once. No published guide yet maps all 8, so buy each garage property as you find it and keep the money ready.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Scooter Bros is an in-game app for registering vehicles; register 10 different vehicles through it. Any 10 count, so register vehicles as you discover them.
